name: Tachibana Typhoon
original_name: 橘台風 -たちばなたいふ〜ん-
source:
Main character is a lonely second-year student with no money. Love and money don't come by themselves. So he is going to hard and get both during these summer vacations by working at a beach cafe.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名身无分文、孤独寂寞的高中二年级学生。爱情和金钱都不会自己找上门来。因此，这个暑假他要在海边咖啡馆努力工作，把两者都收入囊中。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
